author: sjm41
body:
* **ARBA rule (ID and label):**
ARBA00004725

* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
Dmel Q9W374 (su(r), FBgn0086450)

* **Description of issue**
ARBA00004725 adds UniPathway:UPA00070 (UMP biosynthesis via de novo pathway), resulting in a GO annotation to 'GO:0044205 'de novo' UMP biosynthetic process'.
But this protein (and its human ortholog, Q12882) is involved in pyrimidine **catabolism**, so this UniPathway and GO annotation are wrong.

Not sure of underlying cause here.

@rozaru
title: ARBA2GO issue: ARBA00004725

author: rozaru
body: The original manual annotation for this protein was wrong and has been corrected. Maybe this will help ARBA to correct itself.

author: Antonialock
body:
Interesting....
it is annotated to this from matching these 3 interpros:
IPR013785; Aldolase_TIM
IPR005720; Dihydroorotate_DH_cat
IPR001295; Dihydroorotate_DH_CS

we have 500+ entries matching this interpro combination in swiss-prot, they all look like they belong to the dihydroorotate dehydrogenase family
https://www.uniprot.org/uniprotkb?query=%28xref%3Ainterpro-IPR001295%29+AND+%28xref%3Ainterpro-IPR005720%29+AND+%28xref%3Ainterpro-IPR001295%29&facets=reviewed%3Atrue

there are around 300 trembl entries that match this interpro combination + ec:1.3.1.2 (Dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase) 
https://www.uniprot.org/uniprotkb?query=%28xref%3Ainterpro-IPR001295%29+AND+%28xref%3Ainterpro-IPR005720%29+AND+%28xref%3Ainterpro-IPR001295%29+AND+%28ec%3A1.3.1.2%29
So I will curate the drosophila entry so that this domain combination ("condition") disappears from ARBA00004725
